summary: `where_is` can now say how fast someone is moving, when Life360 knows.
details: Life360's own reported ground speed is carried alongside a person's position and shown once it's above a small jitter floor (~3 km/h) — a stationary or slow-walking phone won't produce a false reading.
The `driving` flag already shown before is unchanged and independent of this.
limitations: Only present when Life360's phone reports a usable speed reading — absent, not zero, when it doesn't.
